title: Dumb Patrick
blurb: Bikini Bottom's most confidently unintelligent resident, preserved in audio. Patrick Star has spent a quarter of a century being wrong with absolute conviction and no discernible shame, which is precisely what makes him the internet's patron saint of the bad take. The character works because he is never uncertain — a hesitant idiot is sad, a certain one is comedy. Play it when somebody says something so misguided it deserves a starfish's formal endorsement, or use it on yourself after realising, several hours late, what the meeting was actually about. Is mayonnaise an instrument?
origin: Patrick Star's iconic dim-witted delivery from SpongeBob SquarePants.
